messages:
eli (pm): throwing up a proposal for a 'fast-pass' onboarding lane for low-touch model submissions. Goal: reduce time-to-serve for community/open models while keeping rollback and customer choice simple. Outline below.
ravi (eng): Love a fast lane. Constraints: must be automatable end-to-end and require minimal infra ops. We should limit to models < 2B params or quantized variants.
audrey (qa): QA reqs: baseline test harness (smoke + 50 sample prompts) run daily during lane, plus a semantic-similarity check vs current pin. If similarity drops > 3% flag.
nina (ops): Ops ask: provide a single fallback mapping per model (explicit fallback_id). If fast-pass fails, route traffic to fallback with automatic throttling. Also need a max-concurrency cap per tenant to avoid noisy neighbors.
cory (sales): From customers, they want clear choices: 1) stay pinned, 2) auto-migrate after opt-in, 3) request extended hold. Can we expose a short TTL (e.g., 45 days) for extended hold?
eli (pm): Proposed lane steps (compact): 1) Submit artifact + lightweight manifest; 2) Auto-smoke in shadow (48h); 3) Small canary (1% traffic, 3d); 4) Ramp based on gates to 25% over 5 days; 5) Soft opt-out window (45d for pins).
ravi (eng): Proposed gates (automated): - p95_latency_increase <= 15% - infra_util <= 75% - semantic_similarity_drop <= 0.03 - token_cost_diff <= +10%
audrey (qa): Example eval command: ```sh
rcli eval run --model <id> --suite lightweight-smoke --baseline <pinned-id> --report /tmp/report.json
```
nina (ops): Deployment policy (yaml snippet):
```yaml
fast_pass_policy:
  eligibility:
    max_params: 2000000000
    quantized: true
  shadow_duration_hours: 48
  canary:
    start_pct: 1
    stable_window_days: 3
    ramp_to_pct: 25
    ramp_days: 5
  thresholds:
    p95_latency_rel: 0.15
    semantic_sim_drop: 0.03
    token_cost_rel: 0.10
  fallback_priority: [same_family_variant, previous_pinned, neutral_cpu_variant]
  pin_grace_days: 45
```
cory (sales): That fallback_priority is great. Also suggest we show a small badge in Console: "Fast-pass eligible" and a tooltip that explains the 45d grace.
eli (pm): Comms plan: quick console modal at time of submit, email to pinned customers 7 days before auto-migrate, and marketplace note. Incentive: feature-credit + prioritized support for first 30 days.
audrey (qa): Test harness needs hooks: record sample outputs, run semantic-similarity (cosine over embeddings) and run a few customer-provided prompts if they opt-in to share. Privacy opt-in separate.
ravi (eng): CLI for ops to abort canary: `rcli canary abort --run <run-id> --reason "quality_regress"` and to list fast-pass runs: `rcli fastpass list --status active`
migrabot: scheduled: `fastpass-run 5161717171 --model redwood/edge-lite-1 --policy fast_pass_policy_v3` :gear:
eli (pm): Decision items we need now: - approve gates & thresholds (eng + qa) - confirm pin_grace_days (prod + sales) - finalize console badge copy (design + product) - legal check for shared prompt opt-in (privacy). If we sign-off by Thu EOD, pilot this Friday.
nina (ops): Ops notes: monitoring dashboards: create fastpass dashboard (latency, error rate, semantic_sim, infra_util) and alert on any threshold breach; pre-create incident channel `#fastpass-5161717171`
cory (sales): I'll draft customer email template and share with product for voice. Will ask key pilot customers if they want early access credits.
audrey (qa): I'll ship the lightweight-smoke suite by Wednesday and add daily report hook to S3.
ravi (eng): I'll wire the automatic fallback mapping and ensure fallback respects pinned-exempt state.
eli (pm): One policy Q: if a pinned customer explicitly opts into fast-pass, do we remove pin automatically at end of grace or leave pin and map them to new model? Proposal: keep them pinned but update pinned model id to new variant only with explicit consent. Default: pinned customers are never auto-migrated.
cory (sales): Strong yes on explicit consent. Customers hate silent changes.
eli (pm): Great. Last ask: any red flags on the eligibility cutoff or thresholds?
audrey (qa): 3% semantic drop is tight but reasonable for small models; happy to iterate after pilot.
ravi (eng): Thresholds look fine; I'll run a small sim today with a few candidates and post numbers.
migrabot: completed: `fastpass-run 5161717171 --status queued` :white_check_mark:
eli (pm): Thanks everyone — will collect signoffs and post the pilot run checklist here. Closing thread unless new objections.
